gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the 48V LiFePO4 rack batteries in these complete off-grid kits come in a standard version and a self-heating version, or that Sun Gold Power's SGR-8K10E ships with the standard SG48100P, while the maker's self-heating SGH48100T warms itself below 41°F (5°C) and costs $152 more per battery at the same store. For a tiny home whose battery sits in an unheated closet or hitch box, that choice decides whether solar can charge the battery on cold days.
standout_why: I compared Renogy's product text for the cited 1200W/2500W/4800W 48V Cabin Kit (renogy.com/products/1200w-2500w-tiny-house-home-cabin-kit), its Cabin Solution 1.2kW page (renogy-1-2kw-essential-kit) and its 2.5kW Essential Plus page, all read through the store's search endpoint. None of that text mentions charging temperature, low-temperature charge protection or a self-heating battery option. They list panels, the 48V 3500W inverter, DC breakers and Bluetooth only. Both ChatGPT answers gave sizing tables and one caveat that starting prices can leave out batteries, and neither said anything about cold-weather charging. I could only see about 1,000 characters of each Renogy page, because the full pages returned HTTP 429, so a spec tab further down could mention it. That is why I scored this 2 and not 3.
kit_items: Complete off-grid kit: Sun Gold Power SGR-8K10E (8,000 W 48V inverter with 120/240V split-phase output, two 51.2V 100Ah SG48100P batteries for 10.24 kWh, eight 450 W panels). It is one SKU in one store, it already includes the DC and PV breakers and the 50 ft PV extension cable, and it gives the 240V output a tiny home's well pump or mini-split needs.

Battery choice for an unheated install: Sun Gold Power SGH48100T self-heating 51.2V 100Ah, in place of the kit's SG48100P. The maker says it heats itself below 41°F (5°C) and has low-temperature charging protection. It is the same 51.2V 100Ah server-rack size and is sold for the same Sun Gold inverters. Sun Gold already ships self-heating 'T' versions of its 10K and 20K kits (SGR-10K25T, SGR-20K30T), but I could not confirm that an SGR-8K10E T version exists.
